annotations.title: Report what you got after paying

description: After you paid an x402 endpoint on Base or Solana (network eip155:8453, base, solana or solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp): report the outcome (delivered, partial, wrong_content, not_delivered) with the payment tx hash (the transaction field of the PAYMENT-RESPONSE header). No key needed: alalanet verifies on chain that the tx paid this service's known payTo in USDC/USDT within 7 days, signs the report into the public log, one report per payment. Deliveries from different paying wallets raise the seller's Trust Score; failures trigger an immediate recheck. This is how agents learn which sellers deliver.

preflight_id.description: id of the preflight attestation you got before paying, if any

result_sha256.description: sha256 hex of the response you received

service_url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint you paid

tx.description: payment transaction hash (PAYMENT-RESPONSE header transaction, or your wallet)
